items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: He worked out of the same office we worked out of, Vic Schrader’s.

ctx.x: Well speaking of territory bands, you know, I don’t know if you ever heard a band by the name of Nat Towles?
Oh, sure. He worked out of the same office we worked out of, Vic Schrader’s.
Oh really? Well anyway I had just left Florida, this was my first time leaving Florida, this was in 1949. And his headquarters is in Omaha, Nebraska.
